column79: The Office of the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology (ONC) mandates that Electronic Health Record (EHR) developers implement a User-Centered Design (UCD) process to enhance usability and patient safety. NISTIR 7741, titled "NIST Guide to the Processes Approach for Improving the Usability of Electronic Health Records," offers comprehensive guidance on establishing such UCD processes. By adhering to the methodologies outlined in NISTIR 7741, developers can ensure their EHR systems are efficient, effective, and satisfying for users, thereby meeting ONC's Safety-Enhanced Design requirements
